info.name: PINAK Mobile App - Complete API Suite
info.description: Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection for the PINAK Consumer Mobile App covering Screens 05–15: Authentication, Location, Discover Feed, Store & Service Details, Table Bookings, In-Store Pay Bill, Payments, Rewards Coins, Ledger, and Notifications.

item.name: 01. Mobile Authentication & Onboarding (Screens 05–08)
item.description: PINAK Consumer OTP login, auto-verification, profile completion, and token lifecycle

request.description: Triggers a 6-digit OTP code to the customer phone number via SMS or WhatsApp gateway.
Resends a fresh 6-digit OTP code to the customer phone number after cooldown.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP. Returns onboardingToken for new members, or full accessToken for existing consumers.
Completes first-time consumer registration with name, birthdate, location, and category interests.
Renews expired JWT access tokens using the consumer refresh token.
Validates mobile access token and retrieves active customer profile details.
Logs out consumer and invalidates the session and refresh tokens.

item.name: 02. India Master Locations & Geo-Radar (Screens 08 & 09)
item.description: State/District/City master datasets, postal PIN code auto-fill, and Screen 09 Radar consent

request.description: Returns master dataset of all 35 Indian States and Union Territories for location dropdowns.
Returns verified districts for the selected Indian state.
Returns postal city/town names under a given state and district.
Auto-resolves district, state, and city from 19,097 Indian postal PIN codes.
Displays nearby merchant count, teaser deals, and privacy shield before OS location prompt.
Saves user GPS coordinates and permission preferences, completing onboarding.

item.name: 03. Discover & Home Feed Rails (Screen 10)
item.description: Header metrics, promotional carousels, category rail, nearby offers, and trending collections

request.description: Fetches consumer profile, avatar, primary city, and default delivery coordinates.
Fetches live spendable PINAK Coins balance, rupee value, and loyalty tier.
Returns number of unread alerts for the notification bell badge.
Retrieves high-resolution carousel promotional banners for the home feed.

item.name: 5. Categories Rail with Emojis & Outlets Count

request.description: Returns 9 verified top-level categories (Dining, Cafes, Supermarket, Kirana, Fashion, etc.).
Returns nearby dine-in, salon, and hospitality service offers with calculated distances.
Returns nearby retail product deals, grocery discounts, and store merchandise.
Returns curated partner outlets with ratings, cashback percentages, and hero images.
Returns theme collections (e.g. Weekend Hangouts, Rooftop Cafes, Organic Groceries).
Fetches recent stores or deals clicked by the authenticated consumer.
Tracks user engagement when opening a store or deal card.
Returns machine-ranked recommendation cards tailored to consumer category preferences.
High-urgency limited-time promotional deals expiring within hours.

item.name: 14. Why Shop on PINAK Benefits Grid

request.description: Returns platform value propositions: instant cash discounts, 2X coin rewards, zero markups.
Returns active dining reservations and booking passes directly onto the Home Feed card.

item.name: 04. Search & Discovery Engine
item.description: Auto-complete query suggestions and full-text multi-entity search

request.description: Fast auto-complete suggestions across stores, cuisines, and product tags.
Returns matched stores, active discount coupons, and products filtered by GPS radius.

item.name: 05. Store & Service Details (Screen 11)
item.description: Hero gallery, walk-in & pre-booking offers, menu mosaic, amenities, and concierge support

item.name: 1. Fetch Store / Service Detail by Path Variable

request.description: Loads complete store view with hero photos, 2X coin perk, pre-booking slots, and walk-in deals.

item.name: 2. Fetch Store / Service Detail by Query Param

request.description: Alternative query parameter format used across web preview and mobile views.

item.name: 06. Retail & In-Store Product Deals (Screen 11B)
item.description: Product item details, discount pricing, stock urgency, and product checkout

item.name: 1. Fetch Product Detail View by Path Variable

request.description: Fetches rich item specs, 2X reward coins incentive, store origin, and reviews.

item.name: 2. Fetch Product Detail View by Query Param

request.description: Alternate endpoint format for product detail view.
Instantly settles in-store retail product bills, credits PINAK cashback coins, and generates transaction receipt.

item.name: 07. Table Booking & Reservations (Screens 11 ➔ 12)
item.description: Slot availability, pre-booking creation, pass retrieval, cancellation, and host desk check-in

item.name: 1. Check Table Booking Slot & Offer Availability

request.description: Retrieves live dining time slots (Lunch/Dinner), capacity status, and available table offers.
Reserves a dining table at the store outlet. Generates digital booking reference and QR code ticket.

body.raw:
{
  "storeId": "{{storeId}}",
  "bookingDate": "2026-11-12",
  "mealType": "DINNER",
  "slotTime": "08:00 PM",
  "guests": 2,
  "offerId": "opt_regular",
  "offerTitle": "15% Off Total Food Bill",
  "discountPct": 15,
  "coverChargePerGuest": 0,
  "includeVipPlan": false,
  "vipPlanFee": 0,
  "customerName": "Priya Sharma",
  "customerPhone": "{{testPhone}}",
  "specialRequests": "Corner table with quiet ambiance"
}

item.name: 3. Fetch Table Booking Details by ID or Ref

request.description: Fetches reservation pass, restaurant address, contact number, and booking status.
Returns history of upcoming, seated, and completed table reservations for the customer.
Cancels reservation and issues 100% cover charge refund if cancelled before cutoff.

item.name: 6. Host Desk - Mark Guest as Seated

request.description: Used by restaurant host/concierge to mark arriving guests as seated.

item.name: 7. Host Desk - Attach Final Bill Amount to Table

request.description: Attaches final food and beverage bill from POS to the active table reservation.

item.name: 08. In-Store Dining & Bill Payment (Screens 12 & 13)
item.description: Dining bill checkout with instant offer discount, waiter tip, coin redemption, and coin earning

request.description: Settles dining bill, records merchant revenue, updates table reservation to COMPLETED, debits redeemed coins, and credits cashback coins to consumer wallet.

  "storeId": "{{storeId}}",

  "billAmount": 2200,

  "coinsEarned": 95,

  "customerName": "Priya Sharma",
  "customerPhone": "{{testPhone}}"
}

item.name: 09. Core Payments & UPI Subsystem
item.description: Payment intent creation, status polling, cancellation, and payment gateway webhooks

item.name: 1. Initiate Payment Intent with Idempotency Key

request.description: Creates transactional payment intent before routing to native UPI app or gateway.
Polls payment status (PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED) following gateway redirect.
Asynchronous webhook callback endpoint for UPI gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, Mock).
Aborts an in-flight payment intent if the consumer dismisses the UPI modal.

item.name: 10. Rewards Vault, Coins & Ledger (Screen 15)
item.description: Spendable coins balance, transaction ledger, and receipt lookup

request.description: Returns available spendable coins, lifetime earned, lifetime redeemed, rupee parity, and tier.
Full itemized ledger of coin earnings, redemptions, and adjustments with timestamps.

item.name: 3. Single Reward Ledger Entry by ID

request.description: Detailed audit receipt for an individual coin earning or redemption transaction.

item.name: 11. Customer Financial Transactions
item.description: Settled bill payments, invoice records, and financial transaction history

request.description: Itemized list of settled in-store dining bills, retail payments, and UTR numbers.
Detailed invoice receipt with payment breakdown, discounts, coins earned, and settlement status.

item.name: 12. Notifications & Alert Preferences
item.description: Order updates, cashback alerts, booking notifications, and channel consents

request.description: Returns alert feed (cashback credited, table booking confirmed, flash deals).
Badge counter for top navigation bar.
Clears the unread indicator for a specific alert item.
Bulk-marks all alerts as read.
Fetches consumer consent for SMS, WhatsApp, and push channels.
Saves consumer channel opt-in/opt-out preferences.

item.name: 13. Customer Profile & Active Sessions
item.description: Profile editing, delivery address updates, and multi-device session management

request.description: Returns profile information, phone, email, and address fields.
Updates personal details and primary city.
Lists active mobile devices and browser login sessions.
Terminates a remote device login session.
